name: Lawful Good
description: Describes a character whose faith in lofty principles belies their fastidious obedience to the law.

name: Neutral Good
description: Describes a character with a highly practical, often nuanced view of morality.

name: Chaotic Good
description: Describes a character who views laws and authority as oppressive and artificial constructs.

name: Lawful Neutral
description: Describes a character who minds their own business.

name: True Neutral
description: Describes a character that is either deeply aloof, or deeply practical.

name: Chaotic Neutral
description: Describes a character given to irrational outbursts and flights of fancy. Likely to provides amusing companionship, though unreliable.

name: Lawful Evil
description: Describes a character who maximizes their own interests while maintaining the required social veneer; a high-functioning psychopath.

name: Neutral Evil
description: Describes an incorrigible scoundrel whose cruelty is restrained only by self-interest.

name: Chaotic Evil
description: Describes a character who displays random and capricious acts of cruelty. Extremely dangerous.
